title: Senior Developer Overriding Junior Team Members in Daily Standups
context: A brilliant but dominant Tech Lead consistently interrupts junior team members, dismisses their code review feedback, and takes over all architectural tasks, causing junior devs to stop contributing in retrospectives.
dilemma: How do you coach the Tech Lead and empower the team without creating a toxic rift?

common_pitfalls: Reprimanding the Tech Lead publicly in standup

star_model_answer.situation: A dominant Tech Lead was silencing junior developers and monopolizing architectural tasks.
star_model_answer.task: As Scrum Master, rebuild psychological safety and balance team collaboration.
star_model_answer.action: I held a private 1-on-1 coaching session with the Tech Lead using the SBI (Situation-Behavior-Impact) model to build awareness. I then facilitated a Working Agreement retrospective where the team collectively established rules for inclusive PR reviews and pair programming.
star_model_answer.result: Junior devs actively spoke up in standups, PR review engagement increased by 40%, and the Tech Lead stepped into a mentoring role.

title: QA Testing Bottleneck Bottling Up Delivery at the End of Every Sprint
context: Developers finish coding 80% of stories on Day 8 of a 10-day sprint. QA engineers are flooded with testing work on Days 9 and 10, resulting in untested stories rolling over every sprint.
dilemma: How do you break the waterfall-in-a-sprint pattern and foster cross-functional testing responsibility?

common_pitfalls: Adding more QA resources without fixing workflow

star_model_answer.situation: The team experienced mini-waterfalls every sprint, dumping all QA testing onto the final 2 days.
star_model_answer.task: Coach the team to smooth out flow and distribute testing throughout the sprint.
star_model_answer.action: I introduced WIP limits of 2 stories in 'In Testing' at a time. I facilitated Dev-QA pairing where devs wrote unit & integration tests before handing over features, and encouraged devs to help swarm on manual testing when QA was blocked.
star_model_answer.result: Sprint rollover dropped from 35% to under 5%, and story completion velocity smoothed evenly across the 10 days.
